test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in straight row facing west. D is sitting at the end of the row. B is sitting third to the left of D. A is sitting to the immediate right of B. A is an immediate neighbour of B and C. E is sitting at the first position in the row. F is sitting between A and E. Who is an immediate neighbour of A and F?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: D is sitting at the end of the row. B is sitting third to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd99add23c27390c70fb526f425ba67d90e72eca435e5a52c8f7780fe3afc962.png] 

All of them face toward the west. Now we place D at the right end because we have to place B at its third left.

Step 2: A is sitting to the immediate right of B. A is an immediate neighbour of B and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c8131f1e41722408e0733c6f53a64664a8fc328c99ce2fcdd945e6d156b90d0.png] 

We place A immediately right of B and then place C such that A is the immediate neighbour of B and C.

Step 3: E is sitting at the first position in the row. F is sitting between A and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b7de414a32ea2b22e993921d32146bd50a44961fb2fb63d6c15d1c7402ae648.png] 

We place E at the end and then place F at the only spot left which also satisfies the condition of F sitting between A and E.

From the arrangement, we can see that **B is the immediate neighbour of A and F.**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2).**
